The image displays irregular white and yellowish mucosal lesions along the lateral borders and dorsum of the tongue. The appearance is consistent with oral lesions, potentially related to a chemical burn or a localized inflammatory or ulcerative process.

random.description: This is a clinical photograph of the oral cavity focusing on the tongue. The image displays yellowish-white nodular lesions and plaque-like thickenings along the dorsal and lateral surfaces of the tongue. These clinical manifestations are characteristic of oral hairy leukoplakia, often associated with immunocompromised states such as HIV infection. The texture appears corrugated and corrugated-like plaques are prominently visible.
